The first generation of enhanced soldiers, or ORION candidates, did not have specialized armor.

The second generation of enhanced soldiers were the first to wear powered suits, the Mjolnir Mk. IV platform. This was built on top of the progress made with earlier exosuits, though much of the design for Mjolnir had to be reworked.

The original Mk. IV was a powered assault armor that was environmentally sealed with 90 minutes of emergency oxygen, featured a heads-up display with multiple visor settings, and enhanced the strength, speed, and dexterity of the user. Over the course of its operational history, multiple variants were released for specialized tasks and combat roles. When it first released, there were a number of designs, but the final production model released in 2535 resembled the version seen in a later strategic simulation.

In November of 2551, a version of Mk. V was rolled out for select enhanced soldier teams. This was very similar to the Mk. IV but featured energy shields. In August of 2552, the final model of Mk. V was rolled out and given to the surviving second-generation soldiers, just prior to a major operation. Along with shielding, this version could also carry an artificial intelligence.

A couple of months later, Mk. VI was rolled out. This version featured all the upgrades of the Mk. V but further enhanced a soldier's abilities and included integrated biofoam injectors, so medpacks were no longer necessary in the case of severe bodily damage.

Around this time, early versions of what would become the next generation suits were rolled out, primarily used by enhanced soldiers from specific teams.

The third generation of enhanced soldiers generally used semi-powered infiltration armor. This was little more than advanced combat armor. It offered minimal physiological enhancement and less protection but also featured photo-reactive plating for stealth capabilities. There were a couple of main iterations of this armor, with the second improving the stealth system.

Some third-generation soldiers were pulled from their original units, such as the members of a specialized team, and given Mjolnir armor.

With the advent of the fourth generation of enhanced soldiers came Mjolnir GEN2, which dropped the Mark system of the first generation in favor of progressive updates. By 2558, most enhanced soldiers, regardless of their generation, had upgraded to GEN2, though there were a few exceptions:

- Some third-generation soldiers, notably from a specific company, continued to use semi-powered infiltration armor.
- One of the few surviving second-generation soldiers used the only known suit of Mk. VII.
- Certain specialized teams used Mk. IV, as both were still out of contact with their command.
